dct_title_s: Orientaliora Indiarum Orientalium cum insulis adjacentibus à promontorio C. Comorin ad Japan - Pascaert van t'Ooster gedeelte van Oost Indien van C. Comorin ad Japan
dct_alternative_sm: Orientaliora Indiarum Orientalium cum insulis adjacentibus à promontorio C. Comorin ad Japan - Pascaert van t'Ooster gedeelte van Oost Indien van C. Comorin ad Japan
dct_description_sm: Map of Southeast Asia focusing on the Dutch sphere of interest in the region. This map is detailed as well as decorative and shows India, Indochina, China, Japan, the Philippines, what is modern-day Indonesia, and the still only partially charted coasts of Australia and New Guinea. Decorations include sailing ships, compass roses and a title cartouche in the shape of a pagoda featuring a Chinese princess, a Chinese merchant, and a variety of Chinese products.; Based in part on a 1666 chart by Pieter Goos.; Reissued by the Ottens brothers in 1745.; North oriented to the left.; In upper right margin: Fol. 21.; Shows rhumb lines.; From: Atlas : tabulae maritimae ofte Zee-Kaarten / Frederik de Wit. Amsterdam : Frederik de Wit, 1675.
43 x 54 centimeters, on sheet 51 x 62 centimeters
